MYBOX는 rclone 기본 지원 서비스가 아닙니다. 현재 버전은 외부:
MYBOX is not a built-in rclone backend. This version supports connecting through an external S3 gateway.

1. Create a personal access token in MYBOX.
2. Install and run mybox-s3.
3. Add cloud → s3 → Other.
4. Enter the gateway endpoint, access key and secret key.
5. Enter the gateway bucket name as the cloud folder.

Automatic gateway setup and direct MYBOX integration are not implemented. Editing files on a real MYBOX account has not been verified. Renew your token before it expires.
